response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced (13+ years) full-stack software engineer with strong web, backend, and low-latency service work, but the role requires SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator performance architecture, and deep neural network workload optimization — none of which appear anywhere in his background. His only hardware-adjacent exposure is C/C++ work on a measurement IDE at National Instruments and robotic-arm tooling, which is far from principal-level silicon architecture. Education (BS Computer Science, 2012) meets the 8+ years bachelor's path in raw duration, but the experience is not in a relevant domain. The gap between his profile and the core technical requirements is too wide to bridge in this role.
strengths: 13+ years of broad, progressive software engineering experience
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work in D at Sociomantic
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, OSS tooling, public speaking
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning or GPU/accelerator workload optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not principal-level silicon IC

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design
No AI accelerator or DNN optimization experience
Deep general software and performance engineering tenure
